Then use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop, Escape to cancel. On this board linked to Communecter, the order within a column is automatic (priority, then creation date): only a change of column counts. Without dragging: the card’s “⋯” menu offers “Move to…”, and Enter on the title opens the card.
dnd.instructions: Press Space or Enter to pick the item up, then use the arrow keys to move it. Space or Enter to drop, Escape to cancel. The “Move to…” menu on each card offers the same operation without dragging.

errorState.detailsHint: Copy this as-is into a bug report: it is what pins the failure down.

hint.canceled: The request stopped before it completed, usually because the page changed. Try again.
hint.denied: Your session or your rights do not cover this read. Sign in again, or ask a board administrator for access.
hint.invalidResponse: The server sent back something other than the expected data, most often an error page. Pass the technical details to an administrator.
hint.network: The request never reached the server. Try again; if it keeps failing the service is most likely down, so tell an administrator.
hint.rejected: The server understood the request and turned it down. The code below says why.
hint.serverError: The failure is on the server side, not yours: there is nothing to check on your connection. Try again, then pass the technical details to an administrator.
hint.timeout: The server ran past the time limit without finishing its reply. Try again; if it happens again, report it with the technical details.
hint.unknown: The application hit an error it cannot name. Try again, then report the technical details.

title.timeout: The server did not reply in time
